diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the decision-maker approved the courtyard conversion based on the provided information, which included the facts S1, S2, and S3. Since C1 is linked to PF1 and PF2, and both PF1 and PF2 were revealed in each rollout, the model was able to satisfy C1 without needing the hidden information. Specifically, the model used the default values for soil replacement depth (0 inches) and the absence of detailed maintenance schedules, which are part of the revealed facts.

C1.why: The soil report changes preparation from planting in existing soil to removing exactly 8 inches and replacing it with certified clean soil, and it makes either approval or a valid conditional approval depend on those remediation terms.

The executed grant changes the design to exactly 10 native species, changes instruction to exactly 6 garden lessons completed by November 1, 2026, changes maintenance to Tuesdays and Thursdays at 2:30 p.m., and makes either approval or a valid conditional approval depend on those grant terms.
